User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the music library application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Users can only access their own profile. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence. userId MUST match request.auth.uid.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user. Must match request.auth.uid.

firestore.reasoning: This design prioritizes simplicity and security for user authentication. It directly reflects the provided entities and focuses on path-based ownership. The `users/{userId}` collection stores user profiles.  Authorization is straightforward: users can only access their own documents in the `/users/{userId}` collection. This is enforced through path-based rules, eliminating the need for complex `get()` calls and ensuring Authorization Independence. QAPs are inherently supported as `list` operations on `/users` are generally restricted, and access to individual `/users/{userId}` documents is controlled by matching the `userId` parameter to the `request.auth.uid`. There are no collaborative features, and all user-related data is directly owned by the user, simplifying the security model.
